maya: Quick check 5 proto-first for new typed endpoints. Need safe fallback for older SDKs.

 tom: Edge should negotiate via Accept header (application/x-protobuf vs application/json). If proto accepted -> proto path, else json adapter.

 ari: Sidecar adapter sounds safest for initial canary. Lower blast radius, can forward normalized json to backends.

 carlos: Quotas must be invariant. Normalize usage to decoded units at runtime and attach x-client-surface + x-transport.

 sophia: Telemetry: emit router.transport.choice and router.fallback.count{reason=negotiation} and split latency by transport. Console needs a transport split panel.

 deploy-bot: For auto-rollbacks require both absolute error rate AND relative increase over baseline to avoid noisy rollbacks. Add a short stabilization window.

 maya: UX: reuse per-route weight overrides for a slider in Console + a panic button to set weight=0. Product wants client-version heatmap.

 tom: Implementation note: adapter must preserve trace headers (traceparent/b3) and x-request-id. Also return X-RW-Transport for downstream visibility.

 ari: Action items: sophia prototype sidecar + envoy route (EOD Fri); ari add metrics and Console mock (Wed); tom write rollout runbook + tests; carlos doc quota mapping (Thu).

 sophia: ack. I'll post the spike PR with curl examples for proto and json.

 maya: Thanks, all.
